purpose: Verify application submission is allowed when required profile completeness is satisfied.
preconditions: A job posting requires configured profile completeness. The Student profile satisfies that condition and the Student meets the posting's recorded eligibility criteria.
action_or_input: Submit an application for the posting.
expected_result: PCMS permits the application to proceed.

purpose: Verify application submission is blocked when required profile completeness is not satisfied.
preconditions: A job posting requires configured profile completeness. The Student profile does not satisfy that condition.
action_or_input: Submit an application for the posting.
expected_result: PCMS does not allow the application to be submitted.

purpose: Verify a Student meeting recorded eligibility criteria can apply.
preconditions: A posting has recorded eligibility criteria. The Student satisfies those criteria.
action_or_input: Submit an application for the posting.
expected_result: PCMS permits the application.

purpose: Verify a Student who does not meet recorded eligibility criteria cannot apply.
preconditions: A posting has recorded eligibility criteria. The Student fails at least one such criterion.
action_or_input: Submit an application for the posting.
expected_result: PCMS prevents the application from being submitted.

purpose: Verify a posting with all required content can be saved or published.
preconditions: The posting includes a role description, eligibility criteria, and an application deadline.
action_or_input: Save or publish the posting.
expected_result: PCMS accepts the posting.

purpose: Verify a posting missing required content is not accepted.
preconditions: The posting lacks at least one of: role description, eligibility criteria, or application deadline.
action_or_input: Save or publish the posting.
expected_result: PCMS does not accept the posting as a saved, published, or submitted opportunity.

purpose: Verify eligibility evaluation uses criteria represented for the posting.
preconditions: A posting records selected eligibility criteria, such as CGPA, branch, year, or skills. Student data is available for those criteria.
action_or_input: Evaluate the Student's eligibility for the posting, including a criterion not represented for that posting.
expected_result: PCMS evaluates the recorded criteria and does not apply an unrecorded external criterion.

purpose: Verify a TPO can manage postings within the supported posting scope.
preconditions: The actor has the TPO role.
action_or_input: Create, update, or publish a job posting on behalf of or in coordination with a Company/Recruiter.
expected_result: PCMS permits the supported posting-management action.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can manage opportunities within its permitted access scope.
preconditions: The Company/Recruiter has an authorization state and access scope that permit opportunity management.
action_or_input: Create or submit a job or internship opportunity and define its eligibility criteria.
expected_result: PCMS permits the requested actions within the authorized scope.

purpose: Verify opportunity actions outside a Company/Recruiter's permitted access scope are unavailable.
preconditions: The Company/Recruiter lacks authorization for the requested opportunity action or scope.
action_or_input: Attempt to publish or submit an opportunity, or define its criteria, outside the permitted scope.
expected_result: PCMS does not permit the action outside the authorized scope.

source_id: PC-BR-007 represented authorization permits Company functions
purpose: Verify Company functions are available when the represented authorization state permits them.
preconditions: The Company's represented authorization state permits the requested Company function.
action_or_input: Use a Company function, such as opportunity management.
expected_result: PCMS permits the function according to the represented authorization state.

source_id: PC-BR-007 represented authorization does not permit Company functions
purpose: Verify Company functions are unavailable when the represented authorization state does not permit them.
preconditions: The Company's represented authorization state does not permit the requested Company function.
action_or_input: Attempt to use the Company function.
expected_result: PCMS does not make the function available.

purpose: Verify a Company/Recruiter can access and manage applications for its own authorized opportunities.
preconditions: The Company/Recruiter is authorized for the opportunity and an application exists for it.
action_or_input: View or manage the application.
expected_result: PCMS permits the application access or action within that opportunity scope.

purpose: Verify a Company/Recruiter cannot access or manage applications outside its authorized opportunity scope.
preconditions: An application exists for an opportunity outside the Company/Recruiter's authorized scope.
action_or_input: Attempt to view or change the application.
expected_result: PCMS limits access and actions to the Company's own authorized opportunities.

purpose: Verify a TPO can perform supported application-management actions.
preconditions: The actor has the TPO role and an application is available for management.
action_or_input: View, review, filter, or administratively manage the application.
expected_result: PCMS permits the supported action within the TPO's application-management scope.

purpose: Verify a complete interview schedule can establish Interview Scheduled status.
preconditions: An eligible and shortlisted Student has an application. The schedule includes an interview date, time slot, and mode of online or offline.
action_or_input: Record the interview schedule.
expected_result: PCMS records the schedule and may establish Interview Scheduled status.

purpose: Verify required schedule details must be present before Interview Scheduled is established.
preconditions: An eligible and shortlisted Student has an application. The proposed schedule omits at least one of interview date, time slot, or online/offline mode.
action_or_input: Attempt to record the schedule and establish Interview Scheduled status.
expected_result: PCMS does not establish Interview Scheduled without the required schedule fields.

purpose: Verify recording an interview schedule triggers a notification for eligible, shortlisted Students.
preconditions: An interview schedule is recorded for an eligible and shortlisted Student.
action_or_input: Record the interview schedule.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an interview notification event for the Student.

purpose: Verify a Student can respond to an offer when the represented deadline condition allows it.
preconditions: An offer is extended and its response deadline is represented in PCMS. The current response is within that deadline condition.
action_or_input: Accept or reject the offer.
expected_result: PCMS permits the offer response.

purpose: Verify a Student cannot respond when the represented deadline condition does not allow it.
preconditions: An offer is extended and its response deadline is represented in PCMS. The current response is outside that deadline condition.
action_or_input: Attempt to accept or reject the offer.
expected_result: PCMS does not permit the response.

purpose: Verify accepting an offer updates the offer state and placement record.
preconditions: A Student has an Offer Extended offer and the represented deadline condition permits a response.
action_or_input: Accept the offer.
expected_result: PCMS records the offer as accepted and updates the placement record accordingly.

purpose: Verify PCMS applies only multiple-offer policy logic explicitly represented in the system.
preconditions: A Student has multiple offers and a relevant institutional policy rule is explicitly represented in PCMS.
action_or_input: Exercise the represented multiple-offer condition.
expected_result: PCMS applies only the represented policy logic to restrict, record, notify, or report the situation as specified by that logic.

purpose: Verify PCMS does not invent multiple-offer restrictions when policy logic is not represented.
preconditions: A Student has multiple offers and no relevant institutional policy logic is represented in PCMS.
action_or_input: Exercise the multiple-offer condition.
expected_result: PCMS does not apply an unsupported restriction or policy interpretation.

purpose: Verify Students see only available anonymized placement statistics and historical data.
preconditions: Placement statistics and historical data are available, including sensitive identifying information.
action_or_input: Request placement statistics or historical placement data as a Student.
expected_result: PCMS displays only anonymized statistics and historical data made available to Students; unrestricted sensitive placement data is not displayed.

purpose: Verify announcements within the specified placement-related scope can be accepted.
preconditions: The actor is authorized to create announcements.
action_or_input: Create an announcement about a placement drive, company visit, training session, workshop, or another actor-specific official topic listed in the Problem Statement.
expected_result: PCMS accepts the placement-related announcement within the supported scope.

purpose: Verify announcements outside the supported placement-related scope are not accepted.
preconditions: The actor is authorized to create announcements.
action_or_input: Create an announcement unrelated to the supported placement topics.
expected_result: PCMS does not accept the unrelated announcement as a supported placement announcement.

purpose: Verify Alumni can view placement data permitted for mentorship or networking.
preconditions: An Alumni actor requests placement data available for mentorship or networking.
action_or_input: View the permitted placement data.
expected_result: PCMS permits the read-only view within the Alumni's restricted access scope.

purpose: Verify Alumni cannot modify placement data without a later explicitly supported action.
preconditions: An Alumni actor has read access to placement data and no later specification grants a modification action.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify the placement data.
expected_result: PCMS denies the modification.

source_id: PC-BR-020 Alumni active placement workflow prohibition
purpose: Verify Alumni cannot participate in active placement workflows.
preconditions: The actor has the Alumni role.
action_or_input: Attempt each applicable active action: apply, shortlist, schedule an interview, issue an offer, and accept an offer.
expected_result: PCMS blocks each attempted active placement action.

source_id: PC-BR-021 supported notification event email handoff
purpose: Verify each supported notification event produces a system-generated email handoff without assuming unspecified recipients.
preconditions: A supported notification event occurs: new job posting, application submission, shortlisting update, rejection update, interview schedule, job offer, or announcement. Any specified or configured recipient set is available.
action_or_input: Trigger each of the seven supported notification events.
expected_result: For each event, PCMS generates and hands off the supported email notification using only specified or configured recipient sets. The test checks PCMS handoff, not central email infrastructure delivery.

purpose: Verify an actor can perform functions and access data authorized for the actor's PCMS role and scope.
preconditions: The actor has a PCMS role and scope authorizing the requested function or data item.
action_or_input: Request the authorized function or data item.
expected_result: PCMS permits the role-authorized access or action.

source_id: PC-BR-022 access and action outside role scope
purpose: Verify an actor cannot access data or perform actions outside the actor's PCMS role and scope.
preconditions: The actor's PCMS role or scope does not authorize the requested function or data item.
action_or_input: Request the unauthorized function or data item.
expected_result: PCMS denies the access or action.

purpose: Verify an authorized stakeholder can view sensitive placement data within their access scope.
preconditions: The actor is authorized to view the requested sensitive placement data.
action_or_input: Request the sensitive placement data.
expected_result: PCMS permits the view within the authorized scope, subject to the separate Student statistics restriction where applicable.

purpose: Verify an unauthorized actor cannot view sensitive placement data.
preconditions: The actor is not authorized to view the requested sensitive placement data.
action_or_input: Request the sensitive placement data.
expected_result: PCMS denies the view.

purpose: Verify an authorized stakeholder can modify sensitive placement data within their access scope.
preconditions: The actor is authorized to modify the requested sensitive placement data.
action_or_input: Modify the sensitive placement data.
expected_result: PCMS permits the modification within the authorized scope.

purpose: Verify an unauthorized actor cannot modify sensitive placement data.
preconditions: The actor is not authorized to modify the requested sensitive placement data.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify the sensitive placement data.
expected_result: PCMS denies the modification.

source_id: PC-BR-025 referenced or imported academic data
purpose: Verify PCMS uses academic data represented for its supported placement functions while treating the data as externally owned.
preconditions: Academic data is referenced or imported for a PCMS profile, eligibility, reporting, or placement-record use.
action_or_input: Use the represented academic data in the supported PCMS function.
expected_result: PCMS uses only the represented data needed for that function and does not claim ownership of the academic master data.

purpose: Verify PCMS does not provide academic master-data management functions.
preconditions: An actor requests an academic master-data management operation.
action_or_input: Attempt to create or manage academic master data through PCMS.
expected_result: PCMS does not provide the academic master-data management operation.

purpose: Verify PCMS enforces module access using the available platform identity and role context.
preconditions: An actor with an available platform identity and role context requests a PCMS function or data item.
action_or_input: Request access to the function or data item.
expected_result: PCMS enforces the applicable PCMS role and access restrictions.

source_id: PC-BR-026 platform authentication and RBAC administration boundary
purpose: Verify platform-wide identity and RBAC administration are outside PCMS scope.
preconditions: An actor requests platform-wide authentication, identity-administration, or RBAC-infrastructure management through PCMS.
action_or_input: Attempt the platform-wide administration operation in PCMS.
expected_result: PCMS does not provide platform-wide authentication, identity administration, or RBAC infrastructure management.

source_id: PC-BR-029 TPO Student and Alumni placement-record update
purpose: Verify a TPO can update Student and Alumni placement records within the supported record-maintenance function.
preconditions: The actor has the TPO role and a supported Student or Alumni placement record is available.
action_or_input: Update the placement record.
expected_result: PCMS permits the update within the TPO's record-maintenance scope.

purpose: Verify PCMS records and exposes authorized recruitment status information supplied through supported actions without making the external selection decision.
preconditions: An authorized Company/Recruiter supplies a supported shortlist, interview, offer, rejection-update, or placement-status update.
action_or_input: Submit the supported status update through PCMS.
expected_result: PCMS records and exposes the authorized update within scope; it does not claim to make the external recruiting-company decision.
